name: BFC burns 2% of each pair-bound transfer from the pair
summary: BFCToken._transfer() records 2% of every transfer into its BUSDT pair as lastTx and, on the next transfer into the pair, burns that amount from the pair's own balance and calls sync(). The attacker bought BFC with flash-swapped BUSDT, then looped transfer-to-pair, skim() back and a zero transfer to the pair, so each round burned 2% of its circulating amount out of the pair's reserve at no cost beyond fees; with the BFC reserve shrunk it sold for the pair's BUSDT.
notes: The victim is the BUSDT/BFC pair 0x71e1949a; BFC is unpriced and crashed (rule 12). The owner lowered toUsdtFee from 99.5% to 2.5% (0x17f345f2) six hours before; a fee level is not a reset. No other transaction burns BFC from the pair more than three times.
